items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: And then when his wife come back, after she died, she come right back there, and they're there about six months.

ctx.x: Oh, Chicago. They had him, Hellman Umphrey on the, on the Clown-Eyed. He said, he had a bass. And he said, it was old time fellas. I can't remember them, you know, when he first started out. And then when he left here, he left here with a bunch of fellas from here, you know. Then he sent to Lewis Armstrong. And I said, they stayed together. But he was still living around the corner from here. On the street. And then when his wife come back, after she died, she come right back there, and they're there about six…
Well, she's on Phillip Street now. On Phillip Street?
